messages:
maya: kicking off edge-net smoke for iad5-gpu cluster bringup. focusing on routing, tgw peering, nat+egress, and dns delegation. will run basic flow tests, tagging folks: @ryan @leo

ryan: on it. I pushed TGW attachment + route table earlier. can someone confirm route propagation to the app subnets?

netops-bot: TGW-attach i-attach-iad5 created, propagation status: pending -> success (30s). logs: /logs/tgw/2065432100

leo: seeing routes from tgw-rt-008 in VPC route table for app-subnet-1 -> tgw-id. good.

sara: launched NAT gateway pool (nat-pool-iad5-1) with 4 EIPs. watch for EIP churn; recommend autoscale to 6 if traffic spikes. Also created egress policy to restrict healthcheck IPs.

maya: smoke test: curl from app node to api.redwood.app returned 200, saw source IP from nat-pool-iad5-1:eip-3. traceroute shows tgw->nat path ok.

ryan: quick checks: outbound DNS to route53 resolver passing? run dig against regional resolver: dig +short @172.31.2.10 api.redwood.app

leo: pasted run:

```
$ dig @172.31.2.10 api.redwood.app +short
3.120.45.10
```

sara: DNS delegation: created private hosted zone z-priv-iad5 and associated with VPCs. TTL 60s for quicker rollback.

maya: observed intermittent 5xxs from model-serving during larger payload test. logs show "connect timeout to model-cache" correlated with kernel-batch ramp. suspect ephemeral NAT port exhaustion.

ryan: check NAT metrics: NAT gateway 1 ports used peaked at 56000/64000, hits NAT translation limit. we need prefix-based NAT or increase NAT count. costing note: adding two more NATs adds ~$1.6k/mo.

sara: propose enable 1:1 EIP translation via "NAT pools" + sticky ports + enable prefix delegation if cloud supports. alternatively we can configure proxy egress for cache traffic to reduce ephemeral ports.

leo: meanwhile routing failover test: I removed TGW route on purpose, app traffic failedover to fallback model variant in us-west via smart-routing -> worked as expected :thumbsup:

maya: can we add a step in the runbook to bump NAT count and re-run stress test, plus an ops page for cost delta? I'll add items.

ryan: I'll open a PR to the runbook repo with exact CLI snippets and terraform delta.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: runbook/pr-512 -> staging, status: success.

maya: finalize: handoff to oncall for tomorrow morning for longer soak. tagging @eng-oncall for coverage.

sara: added entries to cost spreadsheet: NAT+EIP add = 1.6k/mo, DNS private assoc is nil, TGW data processing estimated +0.2k/mo.

leo: thanks team. leaving notes in the thread. :rocket:
